tasks.label: Seed dev env from prod
tasks.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Application Support/gitcito-dev" && rm -f "$HOME/Library/Application Support/gitcito-dev/"gitcito-* && cp "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Gitcito/"gitcito-* "$HOME/Library/Application Support/gitcito-dev/" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
